title: Understanding and Defending VLM Jailbreaks via Jailbreak-Related Representation Shift
abstract: arXiv:2603.17372v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs) often exhibit weakened safety alignment with the integration of the visual modality. Even when text prompts contain explicit harmful intent, adding an image can substantially increase jailbreak success rates. In this paper, we observe that VLMs can clearly distinguish benign inputs from harmful ones in their representation space. Moreover, even among harmful inputs, jailbreak samples form a distinct internal state that is separable from refusal samples. These observations suggest that jailbreaks do not arise from a failure to recognize harmful intent. Instead, the visual modality shifts representations toward a specific jailbreak state, thereby leading to a failure to trigger refusal. To quantify this transition, we identify a jailbreak direction and define the jailbreak-related shift as the component of the image-induced representation shift along this direction. translated_title: 通过越狱相关表征偏移理解与防御视觉语言模型的越狱攻击
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型在引入视觉模态后往往表现出安全对齐的减弱。即使文本提示中包含明显的有害意图，添加一张图像也能大幅提高越狱成功率。在本文中，我们观察到视觉语言模型在其表征空间中能够清晰地区分良性输入与有害输入。此外，即使在有害输入之中，越狱样本也会形成一种独特的内部状态，可与拒绝样本分离开来。这些观察表明，越狱并非源于模型未能识别有害意图。相反，视觉模态会将表征推向一种特定的越狱状态，从而导致模型无法触发拒绝响应。为了量化这一转变，我们识别出了一个越狱方向，并将越狱相关偏移定义为图像引起的表征偏移在该方向上的分量。我们的分析表明……
tldr: 该研究揭示视觉语言模型的越狱并非源于对有害意图识别的失败，而是视觉模态将表征推向特定越狱状态所致，并通过定义越狱相关表征偏移来量化这一现象，为理解和防御越狱攻击提供了新途径。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that VLM jailbreaks arise not from a failure to recognize harmful intent but from the visual modality shifting representations toward a specific jailbreak state, and proposes quantifying this via a jailbreak-related representation shift to understand and defend against jailbreak attacks.
